subject: FW: Copperfield Insurance Partners - $1,295MM Term Loan B Refinancing - Launch
body:
Refi officially launched today. Lender call is at 12:30pm ET, commitments due Thursday the 13th at noon.

-----Original Message-----
From: Syndicated Finance <syndicate@silverlinepartners.example>
Sent: Wednesday, August 5, 2026 9:41 AM
Subject: Copperfield Insurance Partners - $1,295MM Term Loan B Refinancing - Launch

Silverline Partners, on behalf of the arranger group, is pleased to announce the launch of the $1,295 million Term Loan B for Copperfield Insurance Partners ("Copperfield").

Borrower:            Copperfield Insurance Partners
Sponsors:            Granite Peak Capital, Tidewater Partners, Meadowbrook Equity
Facility:            $1,295 million Term Loan B
Tenor:               7 years
Use of Proceeds:     Refinance the existing Term Loan B due 2028 and extend the $300 million revolving credit facility to 2031
Financial Covenant:  Cov-Lite
Existing Ratings:    CFR B3 / B (Stable); Secured B3 / B
Arrangers:           Silverline Partners-led arranger group
Business:            Property and casualty and employee-benefits specialty insurance brokerage

Timing:
Lender Call:         Wednesday 8/5 at 12:30pm ET
Commitments Due:     Thursday 8/13 at noon

Materials, including the lender presentation, are available on the deal site (https://syndicate.silverlinepartners.example/copperfield).

Silverline Partners - Syndicated Finance
